task: Analyze the following patent UI snapshot data and produce a section-keyed advisory.
instructions: Classify the patent's strategic role (CORE if high blocking + citations, SUPPORTING if moderate, OPTIONAL if low)
Assess lifecycle stage from citation timing class and growth trend
Provide a technology_insight interpreting CPC distribution and diversification metrics
Provide a market_insight interpreting industry coverage and market diversification
Provide a legal_health_note interpreting oppositions, lapses, renewals, and uncertainty
Provide an innovation_insight interpreting innovation score, tech field influence, and field attention
Provide a blocking_insight interpreting blocking power breakdown, forward impact, family breadth
List 2-3 actionable_recommendations as concrete next steps
Identify strengths with area, evidence (trace tokens), and interpretation
Identify weaknesses with area, evidence (trace tokens), and interpretation
Assess overall risk level and explain

output_schema.strategic_value: string — one-sentence strategic summary with trace tokens

strengths.area: string — e.g. technology, market, legal, innovation, blocking

output_schema.technology_insight: string — interpretation of tech distribution and diversification
output_schema.market_insight: string — interpretation of market reach and industry coverage
output_schema.legal_health_note: string — interpretation of legal events and uncertainty
output_schema.innovation_insight: string — interpretation of innovation scores and field influence
output_schema.blocking_insight: string — interpretation of blocking power and competitive control
actionable_recommendations: string — concrete next step with trace token grounding

trace_rules: Every narrative string MUST contain at least one [[path=value]] trace token
For strengths/weaknesses, the evidence field MUST reference specific data paths
Use paths like: derived.technology_summary.top_cpcs, derived.legal_summary.opposition_count, etc.
